facts.heading: Tomas is nervous about therapy
facts.content: Tomas is nervous about going to a psychologist.
facts.evidence: I am quite nervous, if I am to be honest.

facts.heading: Wife wants things to change
facts.content: Tomas's wife stated that the current situation cannot continue.
facts.evidence: My wife. She says it can't go on like this.

facts.heading: Compulsive checking behavior
facts.content: Tomas checks if he locked the door and turned off the stove thirty times a night.
facts.evidence: Thirty times a night I check if I locked the door and turned off the stove,

facts.heading: Time taken to leave apartment
facts.content: It takes Tomas an hour to leave the apartment.
facts.evidence: it takes me an hour to leave the apartment.

facts.heading: Checking routine details
facts.content: Tomas checks the door, goes to the elevator, returns to pull the handle, checks the stove knobs, and checks the door again.
facts.evidence: I lock the door, I go to the elevator, I come back and pull the handle. Then I check the stove, every knob separately. Then the door again.

facts.heading: Relief followed by intrusive thought
facts.content: After checking, Tomas feels relieved briefly, but then an image comes to his head that he didn't do it properly, forcing him to repeat the action.
facts.evidence: I feel relieved for a while. And then an image comes into my head that I didn't do it properly, and I have to do it again.

facts.heading: Intrusive image of fire
facts.content: Tomas sees a clear image of the apartment on fire.
facts.evidence: The apartment on fire. I see it clearly, like a film.

facts.heading: Frequency of intrusive images
facts.content: The image of the apartment on fire happens every day.
facts.evidence: Every day.

facts.heading: Worst time for intrusive images
facts.content: The intrusive images are worst in the evening when they go out or go to sleep, and also in the morning.
facts.evidence: It's the worst in the evening when we go out or go to sleep. In the morning too.

facts.heading: Fire incident started two years ago
facts.content: The issue started two years ago after the neighbors' house caught fire and they had to evacuate.
facts.evidence: It started two years ago when the neighbors' house caught fire and we had to evacuate.

facts.heading: Experience during fire evacuation
facts.content: Tomas was woken up by the alarm during the fire, saw smoke in the hallway, and people screaming, and they ran out in their pajamas.
facts.evidence: The alarm woke me up. There was smoke in the hallway and people were screaming. We just ran out in our pajamas.

facts.heading: Feeling of responsibility for fire
facts.content: Since the fire, Tomas feels he can cause it, and if he doesn't control something, it will happen and he will be to blame.
facts.evidence: Since then I have the feeling that I can cause it. That if I don't control something, it will happen and I will be to blame.

facts.heading: Inability to stop checking
facts.content: Tomas knows the logic but cannot stop the checking behavior.
facts.evidence: I know the logic. But I can't turn it off.

facts.heading: Anxiety response to not checking
facts.content: When he tries to let it go, anxiety grows until he feels like he is going crazy, and he prefers to check.
facts.evidence: And then anxiety grows in me, until I feel like I'm going crazy. I'd rather do it.

facts.heading: Physical symptoms of anxiety
facts.content: The anxiety manifests as heart symptoms, sweating, shaking hands, and feeling sick in his stomach.
facts.evidence: Heart, sweat. My hands shake and I feel sick in my stomach.

facts.heading: Wife knows about the issue
facts.content: Barbora, Tomas's wife, knows about the issue.
facts.evidence: Barbora. My wife.

facts.heading: Wife's reaction to issue
facts.content: Barbora initially saw the behavior as a habit, but now she sees it is more than that.
facts.evidence: At first she took it as a habit, now she sees that it's more.

facts.heading: Late arrival at cinema
facts.content: Tomas arrived at the cinema forty minutes late yesterday.
facts.evidence: Yesterday we arrived at the cinema forty minutes later.

facts.heading: Wife's reaction to lateness
facts.content: Barbora waited outside for Tomas to return and check the stove for the third time, and she looked at him without speaking.
facts.evidence: She waited outside for me to return and check the stove for the third time. She didn't say anything, she just looked at me.

facts.heading: Reports feeling shame
facts.content: Tomas felt shame and felt like a child who couldn't leave the house.
facts.evidence: Shame. I felt like a child who can't leave the house.

facts.content: Tomas works as an electrician in Olomouc. He does wiring in apartments and sometimes in houses.
facts.evidence: I work as an electrician in Olomouc. I do wiring in apartments and sometimes in houses.

facts.heading: Checks work due to fear of error

facts.evidence: I'm afraid that because of my head I will make a mistake once.

facts.heading: Checks jobs after completion

facts.evidence: The boss tells me I'm the most careful in the company,

facts.evidence: In the last few months, it adds an hour to my work per day.

facts.heading: Handed over jobs due to time

facts.evidence: I've already handed over a few jobs to a colleague because I didn't have time.

facts.heading: Fears losing job now
facts.content: Tomas is afraid he will lose his job, especially now.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I'll lose my job. Especially now.

facts.heading: Barbora is four months pregnant
facts.content: Barbora is four months pregnant.
facts.evidence: Barbora is four months pregnant.

facts.evidence: We waited for it for three years.

facts.evidence: That I will harm her and the baby.

facts.content: Tomas fears the thought of harming them might happen while cutting bread or standing by the stairs.
facts.evidence: maybe when I'm cutting bread or standing by the stairs.

facts.evidence: Walks twice a week,

facts.heading: Fear of exposure therapy
facts.content: Tomas heard about therapy involving gradual exposure to fears. Tomas was afraid of this type of therapy.
facts.evidence: I heard about therapy where a person is gradually exposed to what they are afraid of. I was afraid of that.
